User supplied Dawn recording / extracted frames

requirements.brief: Core thesis, four handoffs, owners, source evidence, unsent draft
Exact five proposed module responsibilities, retained in order
Each product: job, user, inputs, workflow states, evidence, professional controls, output, evaluation, integration questions, FAQ and prefilled CTA
Shared episode model, permissions, source/version/time, owner and exception history
Nine consistent fictional episodes: pending4, blocked2, completed2, rejected1; clean/ambiguous/abstained cases; local resettable review acknowledgement
Primary hospital buyer and secondary ACO buyer, differentiated operating questions
Calls/fax/EHR, Bamboo/CarePort overlap, concrete before/proposed bottleneck and incumbent stop condition
Authorised source, ADT, consent, choice, language, caregiver, benefits, network data, identity, freshness and security review
Handoff audit, staff shadowing, bounded retrospective cohort and conditional paid pilot; sponsor, written scope, owner, input contracts, time box and review gate
Hypothetical $2500/facility/month + $5000 setup, adjacent non-offer label; no checkout
Primary staff-minutes vs baseline, active effort separate from elapsed time, contact/appointment measures, unreachable escalation and erroneous closure guardrails, denominator/open cases/uncertainty
8 qualified interviews,2 approved cohort reviews,1 conditional sponsor with ADT/security route, signed data/security/oversight approvals; stop without owner/source route or if incumbent comparable
Source-backed workflow context and explicit demand/outcome/price/integration limitations
Vision, mission, honest stage, acquisition routes and conditional expansion; no fabricated founders/social links/customer proof
Complete minimal business inquiry, product-interest context, no PHI/uploads, native validation, local preparing/result/edit/download states and notice
Polished sign-in, example credentials, show/hide, tab email retention, secure-link preview, access-help and no false authentication
Substantive guides, source register, downloadable blank scorecard and original synthetic report
Privacy, terms, accessibility and useful 404 recovery
Brand mark/favicon, licensed local typography, full desktop/mobile menus/footer and cross-page journeys
Each page uses one shared continuous background with scroll color changes, connected route, purposeful motion and complete still state; richer teal/ink, limited pale sage contrast
